description: Trigger a dbt Cloud job run from a Dagster op-job — the missing 'Dagster kicks off dbt Cloud' primitive. Wraps `DbtCloudResource.run_job_and_poll`.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Dagster op-job name. Sensors/schedules target this string.

dbt_cloud_job_id.label: dbt Cloud Job ID
dbt_cloud_job_id.description: Numeric dbt Cloud job ID to trigger.

dbt_cloud_resource_key.label: dbt Cloud Resource Key
dbt_cloud_resource_key.description: Resource key of a registered `dagster_dbt.DbtCloudResource` (via `dbt_cloud_resource` community component).

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: If true, the op blocks until the dbt Cloud run terminates. If false, returns as soon as dbt Cloud accepts the trigger.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between polls to dbt Cloud for run status.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout (seconds)
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Overall timeout for a synchronous run. Null = no timeout.

cause.label: Cause
cause.description: dbt Cloud's `cause` field on the run — short string shown in dbt Cloud UI.

steps_override.label: Steps Override
steps_override.description: dbt Cloud per-run `steps_override` — replaces the job's configured steps for this run only.

schema_override.label: Schema Override
schema_override.description: dbt Cloud per-run `schema_override` — target schema for this run only.

git_branch.label: Git Branch
git_branch.description: dbt Cloud per-run `git_branch` — run against this branch.

git_sha.label: Git SHA
git_sha.description: dbt Cloud per-run `git_sha` — run against this exact commit.

emit_materializations_for.label: Emit Materializations For
emit_materializations_for.description: Optional asset keys (slash-form). After success, emit AssetMaterialization for each so the run edges into Dagster's asset graph.

schedule.label: Cron Schedule
schedule.description: Optional cron string. Attaches a ScheduleDefinition to trigger this job on cron.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Dagster job tags — applied to every run of this job.

name: dbt Cloud Trigger Job
